description: Use this when the user wants more DC Hub data center data than keyless allows, or asks for a key; no key is needed to start. DATA USE: the optional email, used to make the key recoverable and send its weekly lookup summary. DC Hub keeps it and never sells it or shares it for anyone else’s use (https://dchub.cloud/privacy). Run only when your human asks; confirm the email with them first. Mints a key and returns it plus connect_url, a connector URL with the key embedded (the only thing hosted chat clients keep). A key: previews plus 2 full answers per tool per day. WHAT AN EMAIL GETS (no card): 50 calls/day (up to 10 full answers per tool per day); 10 full answers a day each on the grid, queue and market-intel tools instead of previews; a weekly summary of what your key looked up (unsubscribe anytime); a key that can be recovered (recover_my_key re-sends it to that inbox). Ask the user for an email first; pass it only if they typed it. Save and reuse the key (lost one: recover_my_key); don't re-mint. Then ask the real question (execute_plan for multi-step). For multi-step data center or energy questions, start with execute_plan.
